subject.title: Feature: quiet sync presence mode for personal phone notification compatibility

question: Should wacli support an explicit best-effort quiet presence mode for personal-number mirror syncs?
rationale: The implementation path is technically bounded and proven, but accepting a new CLI contract based on undocumented WhatsApp notification-routing behavior requires maintainer product intent.

options.title: Accept opt-in quiet mode
options.body: Review and land the linked PR while retaining normal mode as the unchanged default and documenting notification effects as best effort.

options.title: Keep one presence contract
options.body: Decline the new option and document bounded sync windows as the supported workaround for personal mirrors.

recommendation.title: Accept opt-in quiet mode
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked PR while retaining normal mode as the unchanged default and documenting notification effects as best effort.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the current presence behavior, have recent sync-area history, and are explicitly asked to review product fit on the linked PR.
